name: godweave
lore_descriptor: woven from thread like starlight, and weighs no more than a breath
first_pickup_chronicle: Godweave. A thread of starlight pulled from heaven and woven into a blade. It takes blessings and wards better than anything a mortal forge could make.
design_notes: Band F light-enchantable magical_metal. Mult 1.30, weight 0.6 (lightest in game), max_enchant 8 (highest in game). Cannot be cursed. The endgame enchanter's dream — base damage modest, but a +8 godweave weapon is the meta-best.
